lead: An `.lspt` case whose cursor lands on a construct no case had reached costs twelve more cases, not one.
body: `nvs_lsp::coverage`'s vocabulary is every construct some cursor resolved to, so three cases before a `}`, a `)` and a `]` opened `Block`, `Paren` and `ArrayLiteral` as columns and `every_request_answers_every_construct` demanded four cursor rows and a whole-document row at each. Price it with `nvs lsp-test tests/lsp/ --coverage` first, and put a claim about *many* cursors in a `-p nvs-lsp` test, where it opens no column.
